sections.section_title: IAC ILAC input status register x (IAC_IISRx)
sections.text_helper: Section 8.6.4 "IAC ILAC input status register x (IAC_IISRx)" in chapter 8 (Illegal access controller (IAC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 284.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x36C + 0x4 * x (x = 0 to 5)
Reset value: 0xFFFF FF7F, 0x77FF FFFF, 0x77DF F03B, 0x0000 05FF, 0x7BEF FFEF,
0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 ILACIN{i + 32 * x}: Illegal access input {i + 32 * x} (i = 0 to 31)
0: ILAC input {i + 32 * x} to IAC not present
1: ILAC input {i + 32 * x} to IAC present

values.meaning: ILAC input {i + 32 * x} to IAC not present
ILAC input {i + 32 * x} to IAC present
